description: This PHP class defines the EmployeeAttendanceSummaryListModel, which represents a collection of employee attendance summaries for an HRM system, providing methods to serialize attendance data into arrays with helpful calculations and formatting.

classes.name: EmployeeAttendanceSummaryListModel
classes.description: A model class that encapsulates a list of employee attendance summaries and provides serialization functionality, implementing collection normalization and constructor argument awareness.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with an array of employee attendance records.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the attendance records into an array format suitable for serialization, including calculations for hours, minutes, and formatted labels.
